title: Mission Node Editor
subtitle: Author Opening, Phases and End. Named spawn points stay separate from flow.
source.start: Open an existing mission .c to edit its battle rules, units, spawn points and wave sequence. Save updates that file after validation.
source.scope: Supports the OBHK linear mission scaffold. Unsupported runtime code is reported when opening. Your file remains unchanged until Save.
source.layoutOnly: Saves write MSC C. Canvas layout, labels and aliases are session-only.
source.validated: Source compiled; coroutine addresses and binary round-trip passed. Gameplay and target resources still require an in-game check.
validate.scope: Problems update as you edit. Validate runs native compile when there are no blocking graph errors.
validate.blocked: {{count}} blocking issue(s). Fix them in Problems before native compile.
discard.title: Discard unsaved mission changes?
discard.leaveDescription: This mission source has unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?
discard.openDescription: Open another mission file and discard unsaved changes to the current source?
nav.libraryHint: Click to insert into the selected phase. Drag to create a draft and connect it before saving.

details.empty: Select a phase, action, unit or comment. Sequential Opening → Phase → End is supported.
details.help: Each condition starts one sequential phase with a single successor. Opening deploys run first; End stops the authored chain while native win/lose keep ticking.
details.unsupported: True/false branches, loops, parallel author sequences, extra event kinds and 0x601 blackboard variables appear as Planned (TODO) fragments. They do not compile and are not shipped runtime features.
details.openingHelp: Deploy rows before the first condition run during opening. Player and partner slots are initialized by the template. Sequential only.
details.phaseHelp: One trigger and delay, then ordered actions, then the next phase. False triggers wait; they do not take an else successor.
details.endHelp: End finishes the authored sequence. The mission runtime continues evaluating victory and defeat rules.
dock.label: Mission output
dock.stale: This preview is stale. Preview changes to refresh; Save regenerates and validates automatically.
dock.fresh: Source matches the current configuration. Validate checks compilation without writing a file.
dock.noSource: Preview changes to inspect the source.
dock.traceScope: Source-level model, not native runtime. Observed values are typed by hand; this is not a game debugger.
resource.searchUnit: Search a suit name or type an ID

slotParams.heading: sys_0(0x400) arguments
slotParams.unread: The OB handler does not read this value. It is still saved in the script.
slotParams.intro: 0 hold, 1 run forward, 2 fly forward, 3 hop, 4 flip.
slotParams.external: External coordinates can override Spawn X/Y/Z. Turn this off to use those values.
palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Add a phase, action, or run a command…
templates.title: Linear templates
templates.hint: Proven Opening → Phase patterns. Still one successor. No branch, loop or parallel.
templates.opening-deployHint: Clone an unused enemy and deploy it during opening.
templates.alive-gateHint: Wait until at most 1 enemy is alive, then delay 1 second.
templates.message-deploy-waveHint: Alive ≤ 1, delay, A-30-1 cut-in, then deploy a new slot.
templates.deploy-waveHint: Alive ≤ 1, delay, then deploy a new unused slot.
templates.bgm-changeHint: Alive ≤ 1, delay, then change BGM. Edit the hash after insert.
workspace.unbound: No workspace bound. Hashes stay numeric with optional aliases.
workspace.catalogLoaded: BGM list loaded ({{count}} titles from cueHash; unproven as 0x33f arguments).
workspace.catalogMissing: No BGM list in this folder. Maps use the built-in picker; other hashes stay numeric.
flow.valid: Flow is valid. Sequential phases are supported. Generate MSC C to preview or export.
issues.linear-supported: Sequential Opening → Phase → End is supported. Each phase has one successor.
issues.unsupported-control-flow: Only sequential phases compile. Branches, loops, parallel sequences and blackboard writes are not supported by this source editor.
issues.budget-scope: On-field budget is conservative: opening deploys plus later deploys, reduced only by enemies-alive gates. Deaths are not simulated.
issues.e1-scope: Source-level review only. Map, unit, BGM, message and briefing references still require target assets and an in-game test.
issues.end-runtime: End finishes the authored sequence. The mission runtime continues evaluating victory and defeat rules.
trace.debugScope: Simulate the phase chain after opening. Supply observed enemy count, elapsed frames and slot HP. The model uses a 60 Hz countdown that pauses while the trigger is false, and stops after a phase fires. It does not execute game syscalls, model entrance duration, victory, death or respawn. No in-game validation is implied.
trace.terminal: Terminal phase. The template continues checking win and lose conditions in game.
trace.noEvents: No phase has fired. Opening slots are assumed to have completed their entrance.
